context.exploration_scope: Independently validated PHASE-SSI-S15's cap_dataset_management capability-axis candidate by re-deriving the real entity-concentration figure directly from the current LPM (not trusting the records' own cited number), cross-checking the current functional-status overlay and trace chain, and verifying the records' 'same root cause' claim against that independent re-derivation

problem: PHASE-SSI-S15 found a capability-axis signal grounded in 2 real Experience records whose own text asserts a shared root cause (946: 'Same as exp_phase942's cause'), but that assertion had only ever been checked against the records' own self-reported numbers -- it was unverified whether the underlying cap_dataset_management concentration and functional-status claims still hold against a fresh, independent recomputation from the current real LPM/overlay/trace data.

decision.decision_summary: Fresh recompute: cap_dataset_management=2117/2787 entities (76.0%), matches originally-cited absolute count=true. Overlay functional_status=pending matches 946's claim=true. Trace still cites this capability=true. Duplicate/conflict=false. 2 distinct real goals=true, 2 distinct kinds=true. Same-root-cause claim grounded in real data=true. 0 promotion, 0 policy-ization, 0 execution. Verdict: VALIDATED_CANDIDATE.

action.action_summary: Fresh-read both core Experience records; independently recomputed cap_dataset_management's real entity share from the current LPM; cross-checked the current functional-status overlay and the goal_semantic_quality trace chain; re-ran the E12/E23/E33+S-series/S1/S4 duplication-and-conflict check; confirmed the 2 goals and 2 experience_kinds are genuinely distinct; verified the records' own same-root-cause claim against the independently re-derived real data.

evidence.evidence_detail: final_state=VALIDATED_CANDIDATE, concentration_still_real=true, functional_status_matches=true, regression_all_passed=true, dangling=0, duplicates=0

result.note: Independent recomputation from the current real LPM/overlay/trace data corroborates both records' shared root-cause claim -- VALIDATED_CANDIDATE, still not promoted, not policy-ized, not executed.

cause.root_cause_summary: A signal built from 2 records that assert a shared cause in their own text is only as trustworthy as that text, until an independent phase re-derives the same real numbers from the current source of truth (the LPM itself, not a prior phase's citation of it) and confirms they still agree -- self-consistency between 2 records is not the same evidentiary strength as agreement between a record's claim and a fresh, independent recomputation.

lesson: Validating a cross-goal, cross-kind capability signal requires re-deriving its central numeric claim from the actual current source data, not re-reading the two records' citations of it -- an assertion that a correction 'used the same cause' is corroborated, not merely repeated, when the real concentration and functional-status figures it depends on are recomputed fresh and still match.
